models.name: Qwen3.8-35B-A3B
models.why: Empero's distillation of Qwen3.8 reasoning into the 35B-A3B MoE runs ~50 tok/s on a 12GB RTX 3060 with 16GB system RAM by pushing 26 MoE layers to the CPU, ~550 tok/s prompt processing and a configured 262K context.

engines.hardware: RTX 3060 12GB + 16GB system RAM; 26 MoE layers offloaded to CPU (~550 tok/s prompt processing is prefill, never the decode figure)
engines.quant: Q4_K_M, 262K context, Flash Attention, q8_0 K/V cache, reasoning on
